ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the food web, which animal eats other animals?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web, containing plant boxes such as Bengal Bamboo, Strangler Figs, Tualang, Mangrove Forests, and animal boxes such as Sumatran Rhino, Bengal Tiger, Langur, Orangutan, Dawn Bat, Proboscis Monkey. The arrows indicate from the food/source organism to the animal that eats it. Most arrows in the diagram point from plants to animals, for example Bengal Bamboo points to Sumatran Rhino, Tualang points to Dawn Bat, and Mangrove Forests points to Proboscis Monkey. There is an arrow in the diagram from Sumatran Rhino to Bengal Tiger. Reasoning: Because the arrows go from the organism being eaten to the animal that eats it, Sumatran Rhino is eaten by Bengal Tiger. Sumatran Rhino is an animal, therefore Bengal Tiger is the animal in the diagram that eats other animals.
